# Contributing

Add providers to the relevant network section in README.md and to MultiChain when appropriate. Solana-only providers belong in Solana.

Use the provider name and an official HTTPS link. Support network coverage claims with official documentation in your pull request. Avoid duplicates, referral links and unsupported pricing or performance claims.

For public RPC URLs, specify the network, mainnet or testnet, authentication requirements and an official source. Never include API keys.
